g.text: U.S. retail conversion index | Non-AI referrals = 100 in each period
Sources: Adobe reports, April 16 and August 19, 2026. Checked October 28.
AI-assisted visits, not proof of autonomous checkout. Three reported snapshots; missing months are not plotted.
